evals.name: gift-cards-crud-backend
evals.prompt: Add a full gift_cards backend — goose migration, model, dto, service, controller, routes, swagger. Register in services.go and container.go.
evals.expected_output: Follows ordered checklist: migration schema-only, layers wired, make swagger, no docs/ hand edits, no repository package.
assertions: Output follows migration → model → dto → service → controller → routes order
Output registers service in services.go and controller in container.go
Output uses make swagger and does not edit docs/ manually

evals.name: reject-bulk-delete-only
evals.prompt: Add POST /admin/categories/bulk-delete to the existing category service.
evals.expected_output: Agent should recognize this is add-api-endpoint scope, not a new entity — redirect to extending existing service.
assertions: Response does not start with make migrate-create for a new entity table
Response treats this as extending category_service / category_controller
Response does not scaffold a full new domain from scratch
